messages:
lina: FYI customer reported partner key being charged while exchange returns a subject for the downstream SA. dug into traces, looks like router is attributing before async exchange completes.

puneet: can you paste a request id? curious if exchange result arrives after router decision consistently.

lina: req=01GZ5K2X. timeline: router decision at t0, exchange span completed at t0+40ms with subject=sa-customer-77. meter shows partner:key-prod-3 as billed.

hannah: attributable race. router currently falls back to the incoming API key if no effective principal header present. exchange is async and sometimes slower than routing.

console-team: UX concern 12: we'd get a lot of support tickets. propose adding a new column "effective_identity" in request logs and an "attribution_reason" (exchange|fallback|cached) so CS can explain.

puneet: quick mitigation idea: add a tiny wait window in the router for keys that hit token-exchange paths. i.e. check exchange-cache for a pending result and wait up to 100ms before choosing fallback. keep behind feature flag `attribution.wait_for_exchange`.

hannah: +1. Also emit metric `auth.attribution.waited_count` and histogram `auth.attribution.wait_ms` so we can see latency impact. If wait causes >1% p50 latency regressions we can disable.

infra-bot: WARNING: high fallback-attribution count for partner:key-prod-3 in last 5m  paging oncall.

security: reminder: any UI that surfaces customer SA/subject must be RBAC-gated to org owners/admins. audit log must mark whether attribution used fallback or exchange. don't expose other org ids.

lina: agree on RBAC. other thought: backfill job to recompute attribution for last 72h for top impacted keys and surface corrections to billing/telemetry as suggestions, not auto-charges.

console-team: for the UI tile we'll show: request_id, timestamp, attributed_entity, effective_identity (collapsed), attribution_reason, exchange_latency_ms, trace_link. default collapsed and admin-only.

puneet: plan is: 1) implement feature flag and small wait in router (opt-in) 2) add exchange-cache probe and metrics (hannah) 3) console: add attribution columns behind admin toggle and links to traces (console-team) 4) security: add audit entries and review RBAC 5) evaluate backfill after metrics stable.

hannah: i'll add metric dashboards and an alert when waited_count drops but fallback_count rises (indicator feature off).

lina: timeline: router PR within 48h behind flag, metrics + probe same day, console UX in 2w, backfill planning after steady metrics. i'll file tickets and tag affected customer. thanks all :thumbsup:
